notes.title: "NOTTOLOT" Launch - We Look Forward to Your Feedback
notes.notes:
🤖Loot, Dive, Hijack the enemy!🤖
"NOTTOLOT"
Released on March 26th at 5:00 PM!

"NOTTOLOT" is a robot hijacking game where you take over robots with different functions, solve stage gimmicks, and aim for the goal. Aim for the enemy robot's "Jack(s)pot" to hijack them one after another!

【Request from NOTLLOT】
This game was developed as part of Bandai Namco Studio's rookie training program.

We greatly appreciate everyone playing the game and providing feedback, as it serves as encouragement for our rookie creators. We look forward to hearing your thoughts on X(Twitter), Steam reviews/community, and more.

---
【Regarding Gameplay/Streaming】
Thank you for playing "NOTLLOT".
We allow gameplay and streaming for both personal and commercial purposes, aiming for everyone to enjoy the game casually and joyfully. Please refer to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2512830/view/4127058930771095683?l=japanese]these guidelines[/url] and have fun with the game.

Additionally, you can use fan kits such as images from [url=https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q6zeDlF1YOyvgcmWOHFpLmoqGife2Bql?usp=sharing]here[/url].

Please continue to enjoy "NOTLLOT" in the future!

notes.title: Content Creator & Video Streaming Guidelines - "NOTTOLOT"
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing "NOTTOLOT".

"DORONKO WANKO" is a muddy action game where Pomeranians messily dirty up beautiful homes. Run around freely, make a mess, and get every room covered in mud!
We permit individuals, companies, and both commercial and non-commercial entities to live stream and distribute "NOTTOLOT". Please adhere to the following guidelines, and let both players and viewers enjoy the game together.

---
🤖 Basic Guidelines 🤖

▼ When publishing your content, please include the following information in the video or description:

"NOTTOLOT"
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512830/NOTTOLOT/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2512830/NOTTOLOT/[/url]
Copyright Notice
©Bandai Namco Studios Inc.
Published by Phoenixx Inc.

▼ Feel free to use kits (collections of materials) containing key art and in-game illustrations for decorating your streams and content! The kits are available here:
https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Q6zeDlF1YOyvgcmWOHFpLmoqGife2Bql?usp=sharing

🤖 Prohibited Activities 🤖

▼ Please refrain from editing and posting videos unrelated to this game. Also, avoid using the game in a manner that significantly damages its image or violates public decency.

▼ Do not engage in defamation or harassment of other players.

▼ Do not separately post individual elements (such as visuals, music, audio, design, etc.) from the game. For example, do not extract BGM only and reuse it in videos of other works.

▼ Using posted videos for commercial or profit-making purposes is prohibited. However, using videos posted on video-sharing sites for free, regardless of whether by individuals or corporations, and generating secondary revenue from features officially provided by such sites (e.g., YouTube Partner Program) does not constitute commercial use. You may use these features without any issues. For any other commercial use by corporations, please contact us separately.

▼ Do not infringe upon the rights of third parties (intellectual property rights, honor, reputation, portrait rights, privacy, etc.), or use them in a way that may lead to infringement. If any trouble arises with third parties concerning the use of gameplay footage, please resolve it at your own responsibility. Please note that the publisher and developer assume no responsibility in such cases.
---
※ Regardless of the reason, if requested by the publisher or developer, please promptly delete the post.

※ Please note that we cannot provide individual responses regarding our handling or judgment criteria for posted videos. Thank you for your understanding in advance.
